title: Import-hold decision: cover same-owner multi-record coverage, association-insensitive matching and sibling-scope owner fences
outcome: engram_import_hold_disposition's remaining stated branches have table tests. Also, its unused generic journal-error parameter and the candidate's host_incarnation field are documented or simplified.
acceptance: Tests cover: a candidate resolving to the fence's own owner being held even when that owner's coverage is Unknown or its association is not admitted; one owner_id enrolled through several records for one binding with mixed coverage giving Unknown(OwnerCoverageUnknown); a fence of another association_id in the same store and project still holding; owner records in another store or project being ignored during resolution; and an owner-scoped fence in another store or project not making an unbound candidate unknown

engram_import_hold_disposition's journal-error parameter either takes a concrete type or Option, or documents why it is generic, and EngramImportDispatchCandidate::host_incarnation documents that it is the host's current incarnation
the change is reviewed and gated under the standing rule
